title: JANUS Observer Effect Audit

source_question.question: Can an observer effect help solve P versus NP, or does observation create an additional obstruction?
source_question.physical_source: Observer effect: measurement interacts with and may change a physical system.
source_question.terminology_boundary: In physics an observer is measurement apparatus or an interaction channel; conscious awareness is not a required computational resource.

components.M: measurement map producing an observation from the formula and current solver state
components.T: state transition or disturbance caused by measurement
components.pi: adaptive policy selecting the next measurement, representation, branch or Tear language
components.V: polynomial verifier for SAT witnesses and proof-bearing Tears

formal_observer.total_cost_rule: Measurement, disturbance, logging, policy selection, proof generation, verification, postselection probability and witness recovery are all charged to the same total-work budget.
formal_observer.conditional_consequence: If one deterministic observer policy implements every component in polynomial total work for every CNF and always returns a SAT witness or a sound UNSAT certificate, then SAT is in P and therefore P=NP.

observer_roles.definition: Records a deterministic function of the already visible solver state without changing policy.
observer_roles.reason: It can be compiled into the solver and adds calls, storage and timing overhead.

observer_roles.definition: Selects the next variable, branch, module, representation or Tear language from the transcript.
observer_roles.reason: This is the surviving policy-selected Tear route, but it is part of the algorithm and still requires a polynomial worst-case theorem.

observer_roles.definition: Checks a supplied SAT witness or proof-bearing UNSAT Tear.
observer_roles.reason: Polynomial verification does not supply the witness, proof or a polynomial bound on proof length.

observer_roles.definition: Answers whether a partial assignment has a satisfying continuation.
observer_roles.reason: A witness is recovered in linearly many outer queries, but computing each exact answer is SAT-hard in general.

observer_roles.definition: Commits to one observed branch and discards the alternatives.
observer_roles.reason: An unobserved branch may contain the only satisfying witness.

observer_roles.definition: Keeps only runs with a desired outcome and omits the rejected-run probability cost.
observer_roles.reason: Conditioning on exponentially rare outcomes is not ordinary observation and can define a much stronger complexity model.

observer_roles.definition: Physical interaction that produces a measurement outcome and changes a quantum state.
observer_roles.reason: Measurement disturbance is real, but consciousness is not required and measurement alone does not establish a polynomial algorithm for NP-complete problems.

passive_observer.interpretation: The observer adds transcript work but does not change the deterministic search.

collapse_counterexample.formula: (x OR a) AND (x OR not-a) AND (not-x OR b)

extendability_oracle.interpretation: Linear observer dialogue does not imply polynomial total computation.

certificate_observer.UNSAT: bare claim rejected; a resolution-to-empty Tear is verified

observer_as_solution: detects semantic modules without hiding SAT inside detection
selects an appropriate tractable proof language
verifies Tears and preserves witness-recovery information
observer_as_problem: state disturbance may destroy the only valid continuation
the observer output may encode the answer as an oracle
postselection may hide exponentially improbable discarded runs
instrumentation may mistake a transcript artifact for a complexity reduction

observer_tear_laughter_collider.observer: selects what information is acquired and what action follows
observer_tear_laughter_collider.tear: negative proof-bearing information excluding impossible worlds
observer_tear_laughter_collider.laughter: positive witness-bearing information preserving at least one possible world
observer_tear_laughter_collider.required_balance: The Observer may collapse a branch only when a Tear certifies the excluded alternatives or a Laughter witness certifies the retained world.

surviving_conjecture.name: Polynomial Honest Observer Conjecture
surviving_conjecture.statement: For every CNF F of encoded length L, a deterministic polynomial-time observer selects polynomial-cost measurements, representations, module decompositions and proof languages such that every state-changing observation is accompanied by a sound Tear or a recoverable witness, and the complete run uses polynomial total work.
surviving_conjecture.anti_hidden_oracle_clause: No observation may answer an NP-hard extendability, equivalence or language-selection question unless its own derivation is included in the same polynomial budget.
surviving_conjecture.anti_postselection_clause: The inverse probability and all rejected runs are charged unless a physical and computational theorem removes that cost.

research_boundaries: The physical observer effect is not evidence that consciousness changes SAT truth values.
A quantum measurement result is not a free SAT oracle.
A polynomial verifier is not a polynomial generator.
An oracle-relative result does not settle the unrelativized P versus NP question.
This audit does not prove P=NP, P!=NP or NP=coNP.

claim_boundary: Observer is now a precise computational component and a falsification target. The current evidence identifies where observation helps, where it only verifies, and where it hides or destroys the answer; it does not resolve P versus NP.
